task:
IMPLEMENT step 1 of 3 of the Review Lab Phase 2 plan in docs/development/review-lab-v3-redo.md ('Phase 2 design' -> 'Implementation plan' item 1, and 'Owner decisions'). Read that section first; it is merged on main and is the specification. This step ONLY adds the new independent fixture and its builder. Nothing may select or use the new fixture at runtime.

FILES YOU MAY TOUCH (any other changed path is a failure; stage by explicit path):
- scripts/dev/build_review_lab_v3_fixture.py (new)
- tests/fixtures/review_lab_v3_sources/canonical.json (new, generated)
- tests/fixtures/review_lab_v3_sources/source-metadata.json (new, generated)
- tests/fixtures/review_lab_v3_sources/spansh-system-dumps.zip (new, generated)
- tests/fixtures/review_lab_v3_sources/manifest.json (new, generated)
- tests/test_review_lab_v3.py (add tests only; do not edit or delete any existing test)
DO NOT touch: tests/fixtures/cypress_v3_sources/, scripts/dev/build_cypress_v3_fixture.py, scripts/dev/seed_*.py, scripts/dev/review_lab/, apps/, docker-compose*.yml, .github/, sql/, or any other file.

BUILDER: mirror scripts/dev/build_cypress_v3_fixture.py exactly in structure (deterministic subset + rewrite of tests/fixtures/ratings_v4_sources, filtered relations, rewritten system_id64 in rings/body_parent_evidence/bodies, fixed zip member timestamp, canonical-JSON bytes, sha256 manifest, --out argument defaulting to tests/fixtures/review_lab_v3_sources). Do not import from or modify the Cypress builder; copy the small helpers you need so the two stay independent.

THREE FICTIONAL SYSTEMS (rewrite ALL THREE: new id64, new name, new coordinates; none may be kept verbatim). Template system id64s in ratings_v4_sources are given so you can select them:
1. 'Review Wiring'  <- template 164098653  (15 bodies). New id64 9100000000001. Coordinates (100.0, 100.0, 100.0).
2. 'Review Aggregate' <- template 158872029 (14 bodies). New id64 9100000000002. Coordinates (500.0, 100.0, 100.0).
3. 'Review Fallback' <- template 7780836610810 (24 bodies). New id64 9100000000003. Coordinates (3000.0, 100.0, 100.0).
Coordinate intent: Review Wiring and Review Aggregate must fall in the SAME density-pyramid cell at the coarse levels and DIFFERENT cells at the finer levels, so that seven-level reconciliation exercises real aggregation; Review Fallback must be in a different cell from the other two at every level. Cell sizes are in scripts/v3_spatial_pyramid.py CELL_LEVELS (2560, 1280, 640, 320, 160, 80, 40 ly). Verify the chosen coordinates against the builder's ACTUAL cell-index formula (read it; do not assume floor-division from the origin). If the formula makes my coordinates not meet the intent, change the coordinates, keep them positive and finite, and state the final values and the per-level cell table in your summary.

NAMES: the template's body names and raw-source (spansh) members embed the template system names (e.g. 'Achenar', 'HD 38179', 'Wregoe...'). Rewrite those consistently in canonical bodies AND the zip members so the committed artifacts contain none of the ORIGINAL strings: 'Achenar', 'HD 38179', 'V3 Lossless Reach', and none of the old ids 10477373803000, 9007199254740993, 158872029. Also remove any template-system names/ids you rewrote (Sol, Alioth are not used here). Keep every FK/relationship valid. If a rewrite breaks a pipeline validator, fix the rewrite, do not weaken any validator.

COMMIT the generated artifacts (CI reads them; nothing is generated or fetched at test time). The zip must be byte-reproducible.

TESTS to add to tests/test_review_lab_v3.py (follow the style of the existing tests in that file):
a) Rebuild the fixture into a temp directory with the builder and byte-compare all four committed artifacts.
b) Load the committed fixture through the SAME real source loader the Cypress publisher uses (read scripts/dev/seed_cypress_v3_generation.py to find it) and assert it loads without error.
c) Exactly three unique systems; names and id64s equal the table above; finite coordinates; canonical body inventory matches the raw zip members per system (same body count per system).
d) Negative: none of the old names or old id64s listed above appear anywhere in the four committed artifacts (scan canonical.json, source-metadata.json, manifest.json as text, and every zip member's decoded text).
e) Density-sharing property: using the builder's real cell-index function and CELL_LEVELS, assert Review Wiring and Review Aggregate share a cell at the coarse levels and differ at the finer ones as stated above, and that Review Fallback differs from both at every level.
f) manifest.json sha256 values match the files on disk.

VALIDATE and report the exact commands and results: python -m py_compile on the new script; ruff check (use the repo's configuration, target py314) on the new script and on tests/test_review_lab_v3.py; the focused test file python -m pytest tests/test_review_lab_v3.py -q; python -m pytest tests/test_cypress_v3_fixture.py tests/test_seed_cypress_v3_generation.py -q to prove the Cypress fixture and its tests are untouched and still pass (the PostgreSQL cases may skip without RATINGS_V4_VALIDATION_DATABASE_URL; say which skipped); and `git diff --name-only` showing only the allowed paths. If a real disposable PostgreSQL is available, ALSO publish the new fixture once through the existing Cypress seeding machinery pointed at it and report whether canonical bootstrap, Search and Archetype READY/VERIFIED and derived CAS publish all succeed; if no database is available say so plainly, and do not claim it was verified.

Be explicit about anything you could not verify. Do not weaken, skip or delete any existing test.
